events.title: Thank you for 10000 wishlits!
events.summary: This is unbelievable, truly. I just wanted to make a simple incremental game about mining ore with little bits of features that I loved in other games and across genres. And here are 10000 people being interested in my creation, out of which there are 279 of you that have played demo for more than 20 hours... I know some of you from discord have played more than 100 even. It is truly amazing feeling. I hope I can live up to the interest and deliver a good game at launch in few weeks!Thank you, f

events.title: Swarmslam is part of Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Heyo!I am glad to announce that Swarmslam will be part of an upcoming Steam Next Fest, happening during October 19 - 26 AT 10 AM PT. If you played the demo back in July or August, I'd love for you to give it another go during the fest. A lot has changed since then and every player during the fest helps the game reach more people. Even if you cannot play, just sharing it with a friend helps immensely too.So, thank you and see ya on the fest!

events.title: Swarmslam is part of An Event About Incrementals!

Event will be going live October 8 at 10 AM PST, running until October 22 at 10 AM PST.More info can be found here -> https://aneventaboutincrementals.com/Huge thanks and shoutout to the organizers of an event at Cantropic Games, Lazy Otter and Next in Game for an opportunity! events.title: Swarmslam Demo v0.4.3 - Pierce
events.summary: So the playtest is over and there have been very insightful and useful feedback provided. Most of it is being applied and some of them do improve the Demo as well so, here are patch notes of changes that make it into the demo. PIERCEA new damage type, catered towards more early game, to exist as an alternative to lightning and/or black flash. BALANCEMotherlode's Favor: +0.02s per Motherlode cell broken -> +0.15s per whole Motherlode broken Depth Multiplier on Run Extractor: 0.01x - 3.0x -> 0.01x

events.title: Swarmslam Demo v0.3.2 - Build Variety
events.summary: With more and more people playing the demo, the awesome people on Discord started suggesting ideas and features that would make the whole game feel much better. See, before this update there was no real notion of a "build" in the game. If you wanted to switch from dealing damage to farming ore, you had to manually go and remove all the COREBREAKs and put them in different places, every single time. That is the core focus of this patch - build variety QoL, if you want to call it that.SAVE FILESTh

events.title: Swarmslam Demo v0.3.1 - Fixing damage
events.summary: A follow-up update to 0.3.0, trying to tie lose ends and also explore a bit more areas. SKILL TREEBlack Flash has been fixed. it used to overwrite slammer crit, so the moment you'd get crit damage more than 4x (which was Black Flash's default multiplier), Black Flash was basically becoming useless. This was not intentional, Black Flash was always supposed to roll on top of crit.
